source_authority.behavior: load_ntdll explicitly dlopens the installed architecture ntdll.so with RTLD_NOW before resolving and calling __wine_main

classification.stage_internal: dependency resolves from the staged Wine tree through an explicitly proven bootstrap shortname, a strict local first pathname, or the unique target proven across all modeled musl needed_by search contexts for the same ELF identity and SONAME
classification.rootfs_external: dependency resolves from the locked Alpine rootfs through a strict local first pathname or the unique target proven across all modeled musl needed_by search contexts for the same ELF identity and SONAME
classification.loader_bootstrap_shortname: only shortnames declared by the locked Wine bootstrap contract may be treated as already loaded; the exact staged path, rooted canonical target and ELF identity are revalidated before reuse
classification.loader_dynamic_path: DT_RUNPATH when present, otherwise DT_RPATH, with only rooted absolute paths or $ORIGIN expansion accepted
classification.loader_system_path: locked /etc/ld-musl-$ARCH.path when present, otherwise musl built-in /lib:/usr/local/lib:/usr/lib fallback
classification.loader_first_pathname_hit: an existing pathname in the consumer-local search order is never skipped; non-ELF, incompatible or cross-scope first hits fail closed. If the isolated consumer has no pathname, resolution is allowed only through the exact loader-invariance target for that consumer's ELF identity + SONAME after every modeled needed_by pathname is reopened and revalidated
classification.loader_first_pathname_hit_evidence: a content-addressed contextual first-hit proof is bound to the same runtime id, staged manifest and loader-invariance validation digest
classification.loader_needed_by_chain: musl searches rpath/runpath through the needed_by chain before its system path; staged dependency discovery therefore uses the unique target proven invariant across all modeled staged ancestor paths instead of treating every staged shared object as an independent root
classification.loader_shortname_reuse: musl may reuse an already loaded shortname before path search; this discovery proves declared Wine bootstrap shortnames and one reachable logical target per SONAME and ELF identity within staged direct-dependency scope or fails closed
classification.contextual_dependency_inventory: each staged ELF DT_NEEDED edge must be bound to the loader-invariance pair for that exact consumer; local first hits must equal the invariant target and local misses may use only that proven needed_by-context target
classification.authoritative_evidence: a final content-addressed proof binds the full-build proof, contextual first-hit proof, loader-invariance proof and contextual dependency inventory before loader_resolution_verified may be treated as authoritative
classification.ambient_ld_library_path: forbidden for deterministic discovery and future runtime assembly
